When, Where, Description

• Speech by: President John F. Kennedy

• Date: April 27th, 1961

• Location: Waldorf-Astoria Hotel, New York City

• Description: President Kennedy's address to the American Newspaper Publishers Association at a Bureau of Advertising dinner held at the Waldorf-Astoria Hotel in New York City.
